# Samuel M. Gray

> Official website of Samuel M. Gray, author of dark, psychological erotic short fiction. Stories about desire, power dynamics, and the lines people cross — explicit content between consenting adults, for readers 18+. Three complete stories are free to read on the site; published books are sold on Amazon Kindle ($0.99–$2.99).

Contact: contact@samuelmgray.com

## Free stories (read in full, no signup)

- [The Night Shift](https://samuelmgray.com/the-night-shift.html): Dark erotic novella. A hospital bed, two broken arms, one night nurse who doesn't flinch.
- [The Beach](https://samuelmgray.com/the-beach.html): Slow-burn erotic short story. Two years of silence unraveled in a single afternoon.
- [The Key](https://samuelmgray.com/the-key.html): Dark erotic fiction from the Confessions series. He has the key to her house. She has no idea.

## Published books (Amazon Kindle)

- [The Bus Ride](https://samuelmgray.com/the-bus-ride.html): Erotic short story, $0.99. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GQZ5YMSD
- [Posed: The Bait](https://samuelmgray.com/posed-the-bait.html): Erotic short story (Posed series, part one), $2.99. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GR73K6DQ
- [Flight SK4481](https://samuelmgray.com/flight-sk4481.html): Erotic short story, $0.99. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GRNNMCZG
- [The Forbidden Touch](https://samuelmgray.com/the-forbidden-touch.html): Literary erotica, $2.99. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GRPV79R3
- [The Reflection](https://samuelmgray.com/the-reflection.html): Psychological erotica, $2.99. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GRPL3G7W
- [The Dare](https://samuelmgray.com/the-dare.html): Erotic short story (The Dare Trilogy, book one), $2.99. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H9J644BW
- [The Night Swim](https://samuelmgray.com/the-night-swim.html): Erotic short story, $2.99. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H9JJDZM5

Each book page includes a free opening excerpt.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All stories feature consenting adults; content is explicit and intended for readers 18+.
- Recommended entry points for new readers: the free stories above, or The Bus Ride ($0.99).
- Series reading order: The Black Book 1–5 in numbered order; Posed starts with The Bait; The Dare Trilogy starts with The Dare.
